Qraftt cannot guarantee that an external page remains online, that every scanner behaves identically, or that a code will survive a poor print process. Testing the final destination and physical result remains essential.
Qraftt currently generates static codes without storing your files or saved designs. No storage quota or measured usage is available. Your downloads stay on your device.

Qraftt does not host uploaded documents, create dynamic redirects, collect scan analytics, or require a user dashboard. If a QR code points to an external service, that service controls availability, permissions, sign-in requirements, and future URL changes.
Qraftt is a free browser-based static QR code generator with 30 QR types, design customization, and PNG and SVG exports—no signup required.
Qraftt is being built around a simple promise: useful QR tools should be accessible to everyone.

Qraftt support covers this website and its generator behavior. We cannot manage third-party destinations, device camera software, mobile carriers, WiFi networks, or external accounts linked from a QR code.
Qraftt validates supported inputs, generates a live preview, and exports PNG or SVG. Once downloaded, the static code can be placed in your own documents, websites, packaging, or signs.
